coverage.saudiDataNote: No A5 score (Tier 0): structural-variation gene owned by A8; excluded from Goljan et al. 2022 because deletions, duplications and hybrids could not be called.

callability.reason: PharmCAT documentation: 'we do NOT recommend calling CYP2D6 from VCF' because of 'the large influence of structural variation (SV) and copy number variation (CNV) on inferring CYP2D6 phenotype'; 'CYP2D6 UMs cannot be called using only SNPs and INDELs in a VCF file'; and 'missing the copy number of a normal or decreased function allele can misrepresent a normal metabolizer (NM)'.
callability.requiredInput: WGS BAM/CRAM with a CNV-aware caller, or a lab report
